capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Hyundai Canada states 84.0 kWh for the Preferred Long Range RWD only; assumed to be the same Long Range pack.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Battery voltage 697 V (Australian-market sheet; same pack).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: page lists the 84 kWh E-GMP pack (2025 IONIQ 5 Long Range/XRT) as SK On NCM 811 pouch; EV Database also says NMC for the 84 kWh IONIQ 5. Hyundai Canada only says lithium-ion.

charge_port.notes: NACS charge port; two CCS adapters (AC and DC) included.

ac_max_kw.notes: US page: home charging up to 10.9 kW. Hyundai Canada page does not state it. EV Database lists 11 kW for the European car.

wheels.notes: US release for 2025 XRT: unique black 18 in wheels, 235/60R18 all-terrain tires. Canadian XRT assumed identical (same model, year-to-year carryover).
